r: Welcome to the second to the last Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series of 2014 in North America! Many have weathered storms to be here, in all we have 1131 Duelist vying for the YCS Prize card this weekend,

! The format for the past two YCS has been dominated by Shaddolls, Satellarknights, and Burning Abyss Decks but the recent Forbidden and Limited List may alter that a bit. What deck will the champion take into Top 32? Stay tuned as we find out. Welcome to YCS Dallas!
